WHAT WE WILL NOT CLAIMREAD THIS ONCE

Two panels, one person, 128 days apart. That is not enough to say a supplement moved a marker, and we are not going to draw you an arrow that says it did.

What this page does instead: puts what you took and what came back on one timeline, and shows which of your markers your stack even plausibly touches. You draw the conclusion.
